query:
SELECT u.id as userId, u.name, u.email, i.companyName, i.meetingPackage, i.sponsorId
FROM users u
JOIN intakeSubmissions i ON i.userId = u.id
WHERE u.role = 'user'
ORDER BY i.sponsorId;
